entities.name: ABC News
entities.control_summary: Division of The Walt Disney Company. No dual-class controller at Disney. Economic ownership is widely held.

entities.name: The Walt Disney Company
entities.control_summary: One-share-one-vote public company. No controlling family. CEO is hired, not a dual-class controller.
entities.notes: Parent of ABC News, ESPN, Disney studios and parks.

entities.name: NBC News
entities.control_summary: NBCUniversal remains inside Comcast. Brian Roberts holds a fixed one-third voting bloc via Class B. A mid-2027 spin of NBCU is announced, not closed.

entities.name: MSNBC
entities.control_summary: Same Comcast / Roberts voting structure as NBC News.

entities.name: NBCUniversal
entities.control_summary: Wholly owned by Comcast until the announced spin-off closes. Dual-class Roberts control is planned to carry over.

entities.name: Comcast
entities.control_summary: Dual-class. Roberts family Class B is fixed at one-third of voting power. Economic stake is about 1%.

entities.name: Roberts family
entities.control_summary: Holds all Comcast Class B shares. Charter locks that class at 33.3% of company voting power.

entities.name: CBS News
entities.control_summary: Paramount Skydance (PSKY). Ellison family holds 77.5% of voting Class A. The WBD/CNN deal is approved federally but paused by state AG litigation into 2027 — CNN is still WBD until that closes.

entities.name: Paramount Skydance
entities.control_summary: Class A (voting) is held by Ellison family (~77.5%) and RedBird (~22.5%). Class B is economic, non-voting.
entities.notes: Formed August 2025 from Skydance + Paramount Global + National Amusements.

entities.name: Ellison family
entities.control_summary: Larry and David Ellison control Paramount Skydance through Class A. Not yet owners of CNN — that deal has not closed.

entities.name: Politico
entities.control_summary: Owned by Axel Springer. Controlling shareholder is CEO Mathias Döpfner, with Friede Springer.

entities.name: Axel Springer
entities.control_summary: German publisher. Döpfner is CEO and controlling shareholder. Also owns Business Insider, Bild, Welt, and (as of June 2026) The Telegraph.

entities.name: Mathias Döpfner
entities.control_summary: CEO and controlling shareholder of Axel Springer.

entities.name: Bloomberg
entities.control_summary: Privately owned. Michael Bloomberg is the founder and controlling owner of Bloomberg LP.

entities.name: Bloomberg L.P.
entities.control_summary: Private. Controlling owner is Michael Bloomberg.

entities.name: Michael Bloomberg
entities.control_summary: Founder and controlling owner of Bloomberg L.P.

entities.name: NPR
entities.control_summary: Nonprofit membership corporation. No residual shareholders. Governed by a board; funded by member stations, sponsorship, grants, and the Corporation for Public Broadcasting.

entities.name: USA Today
entities.control_summary: Gannett flagship. Public company, no dual-class controller.

entities.name: Gannett
entities.control_summary: One-share-one-vote public company. No controlling family.

edges.source_label: Comcast — NBCU still wholly owned pending 2027 spin
